verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents meeting notes, action items, and customized summaries (fireflies-docs-10) plus an AskFred AI assistant (fireflies-docs-18), but no evidence pack item mentions drafting or auto-composing a follow-up email a sales rep can review and send in a couple of clicks. This is a fair capability to expect from a meeting-notes tool, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
